caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden bucket standing upright against a plain, light beige background. The bucket is cylindrical with slightly outward-sloping sides, constructed from vertically aligned wooden staves that are pale brown with darker lines indicating wood grain. The top and middle of the bucket are reinforced with two iron bands colored grey, secured with visible rivets. The bottom edge of the bucket is wrapped with a thick rope, which is brown and textured. The bucket has a wooden handle attached on either side with round wooden pegs and simple fixtures, and the handle arches over the top. There are no additional objects or details present in the drawing apart from subtle shadowing below the bucket, indicating the orientation and grounding of the object.
title: Milk Bucket
